section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports on the psychometric evaluation of a Romanian translation of the 10-item BAS-2 using a primary sample of 453 university students and a separate test–retest sample of 109 university students. The BAS-2 showed a one-dimensional factor structure, adequate CFA fit, internal consistency, convergent validity, and test–retest reliability; however, invariance across sex was not supported.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary based on multiple sentences in the abstract describing samples, factor analyses, invariance across sex, and psychometric properties.
